This is a large build. Let me start the docker compose build in the background and monitor. First let me build core infra services (postgres, rabbitmq, redis) then the apps. Actually `docker compose up -d` will build everything. Let me run build first with a decent concurrency.

Given 8 cores, 7.6GB RAM, building node apps could be heavy but let's try. I'll start building in background with logs.

Let me start docker compose build for all services. This might take a while. Let me run it with nohup and monitor.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup docker compose build > /tmp/build.log 2>&1 &
echo "started build PID $!"; sleep 30; tail -5 /tmp/build.log
